hero.title: Play. Win.
hero.subtitle: Enter the ultimate FlappyStar tournament. One simple game. One massive prize.

step1.title: Choose Your Stake
step1.description: Entry from €1.00. The higher your stake, the higher your score multiplier and the greater your chance to win.

step2.title: Play FlappyStar
step2.description: Navigate through obstacles. Score as high as you can. Your score is multiplied by your multiplier.

step3.title: Win €10,000
step3.description: Top 3 scores qualify for the live finale on Twitch. Whoever lasts longest wins €10,000, via bank transfer or cash.

q1.question: How do I enter the tournament?
q1.answer: Choose your stake (from €1.00, or €0.50 during the promo period), pay securely via Stripe and start playing immediately. The higher your stake, the higher your score multiplier and the bigger your chance to reach the finale. After the game, enter your contact details and your final score (game score × multiplier) is saved to the leaderboard.

q2.question: Can I play multiple times?
q2.answer: Each entry (from €1.00) gives you one game. You can enter multiple times.

q3.question: How does the score multiplier work?
q3.answer: The higher your stake, the higher your multiplier. Your game score is multiplied by your multiplier, e.g. 15 points × 3 = 45 ranked points.

q4.question: How is the winner determined?
q4.answer: The three participants with the highest weighted scores (game score × multiplier) qualify for a live finale on Twitch. In the finale, all three compete. Whoever lasts longest wins €10,000.

q5.question: How is the prize paid out?
q5.answer: The winner of the live finale on Twitch receives €10,000, either via bank transfer (within 14 days) or in cash with personal pickup at our office in Kelkheim (Taunus), Germany.
